messages:
maya: Alert — p99 spike on streaming inference in us-west-2. Seeing 3x tail latency and occasional stalls, customer-facing timeouts being reported. Start time ~5599989950, now sustained.
incident-bot: [ALERT] inference.streaming.p99 > 3s in region us-west-2. Triggered at 5599989955. Pager routed to #incidents and oncall.
nina: I'm oncall and looking. Quick ask: any deploys in the last 30m?
liam: No deploys from platform in last 45m. I see a barrage of 429s from control-plane when attempting config fetches in the logs.
chao: Also seeing an uptick in auth DB read latency to the tokenstore; p95 ~ 120ms -> 700ms. Could be behind the stalls.
maya: Streaming path depends on config fetch for checkpoint/feature flags and auth token validation. If those are slow, requests block waiting on control-plane sync.
liam: Stacktrace tail from the gateway:```
2026-03-15T08:39:14Z INFO request_id=abcd tail_latency=2.8s waiting_on=configfetch
2026-03-15T08:39:15Z ERROR request_id=efgh stream_stall reason=auth_retry attempts=3
```
chao: Paging pg-replica-3 shows replication lag and heavy reads on tokenstore.feature_flags. Likely hotspot on the checkpoint reads.
nina: Customer impact: ~12 customer sessions currently reporting stalls, several timed out reconnects. Marking as P1. Support ops, can you surface top customers?
support-bot: Top impacted customers (by recent errors): acme-sdks (14 errors), fin-analytics (7 errors), edu-labs (3 errors). Notifying CS.
liam: Short-term mitigation proposal: 1) enable cached config fallback (serve last-known checkpoint) 2) throttle control-plane config fetches from streaming path 3) route new sessions to dedicated pool in us-east-1 if possible. Thoughts?
maya: +1 to cached fallback. We have codepath: CONFIG_FALLBACK=last_known. Command to flip (safe quick):
```
# flip cached config fallback for streaming
curl -X POST "$CONTROL_PLANE/api/v1/flags" -d '{"key":"streaming.use_cached_checkpoint","value":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN"
```
chao: I'm increasing tokenstore read timeout and enabling secondary cache in front of pg-replica-3 (kv-cache TTL bump). Doing cache priming now.
liam: I'll open a short-lived rate-window on the control-plane (increase batching window) to avoid thundering herd from workers. Command:
```
kubectl -n controlplane patch cm rate-window -p '{"data":{"window_ms":"200"}}'
```
nina: I'm going to handoff to chao for live mitigation. nina -> chao : oncall handoff. chao, you're primary for next 30m. I'll stay nearby for comms.
chao: Taking it. Tracking mitigations: cache fallback turned on, cache primed, rate-window increased, raising read timeout. Observability: enabling detailed traces for streaming path.
maya: Adding canary routing: route 10% traffic to us-east-1 dedicated pool as a low-risk diversion. Liam, can you swing that?
liam: Doing canary. Command run. Verified routes updated for canary keys.
support-bot: CS notified for impacted customers with mitigations summary and ETA for full fix.
chao: Quick metrics update — within 90s after cache fallback p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.1s; streaming error rate halved. Still seeing intermittent auth retries (1-2%).
nina: Good improvement. Chao, keep the fallback enabled until we confirm tokenstore replica health. Also please capture a timeline for postmortem.
chao: Ack. Next steps: 1) run pg-check on replica, 2) promote warm replica if lag persists, 3) investigate why feature flag checkpoint reads hot-spotted (range queries?). Will collect slow queries.
liam: I'll correlate recent traffic patterns — looks like a spike of short-lived streaming sessions from a partner integration (high reconnects). Could have amplified reads.
maya: For post-incident: action items so far: cache fallback toggle, increase rate-window, cache TTL bump, routing canary, replica health check. We'll prep a short incident summary for oncall handoff.
support-bot: Noted. ETA to full resolution currently estimated 2h pending replica repairs. Updating ticket INC-2026-5599.
nina: Handing off monitoring to chao. I'll update #incidents with customer impact and closure criteria. Oncall -> resolve when: p99 sustained < 800ms for 10m and auth retry rate < 0.5%.
chao: Will monitor. If replica doesn't catch up I'll coordinate a failover with DB infra. Posting logs and slow-query sample into the incident doc.
maya: Thanks all. If anyone sees regressions revert the cached fallback and route back. Will schedule postmortem with timeline + root cause analysis once stable.
liam: Quick note — keep an eye on any config rollout that touches streaming.checkpoint read patterns; might need a follow-up optimization.
support-bot: CS will continue customer comms and collect any additional error samples.
chao: Update at 5599990060: replica lag improving, p99 ~ 620ms, error rate down to 0.3%. Holding mitigations and continuing to monitor.
nina: Closing active paging — leaving thread open for postmortem notes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
